spec.name: SLICE-004-expired-invitation-message.md
spec.markdown:
# SLICE-004: Clearer expired invitation message

## Summary

- **Actor:** Invitee
- **Trigger:** The invitee opens an invitation link that has expired
- **Outcome:** The invitee is told who to ask for a new invitation

## Scope

### In scope

- The message shown when an expired invitation link is opened

### Out of scope

- None.

## Preconditions

- The invitation link was sent more than 7 days ago

## Invariants

- **INV-01:** An expired invitation link MUST NOT add the invitee to the workspace.

## Functional requirements

- **FR-01:** [Unwanted behavior] If the invitee opens an expired invitation link, then the system SHALL display "This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one."
- **FR-02:** [Ubiquitous] The system SHALL show line 2 of the help text on the expired link page.
- **FR-03:** [Ubiquitous] The system SHALL show line 3 of the help text on the expired link page.
- **FR-04:** [Ubiquitous] The system SHALL show line 4 of the help text on the expired link page.

## Acceptance criteria

### Decision matrix

| Rule | Link expired (Yes / No) | Expected outcome | Side effects | Covers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Yes | Shows "This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one." | None | FR-01, INV-01 |
| R2 | No | Not possible: this slice covers only expired links | None | INV-01 |

### Scenarios

#### AC-01: An expired link says who to ask

- **Covers:** FR-01, INV-01, FR-02, FR-03, FR-04
- **Given** an invitation was sent to "sam@example.com" 8 days ago
- **When** the invitee opens the invitation link
- **Then** the system displays "This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one."
- **And** "sam@example.com" is not a member of the workspace

## Effects on shipped behaviour

None.

## Dependencies and permissions

- **External dependencies:** None.
- **Required permissions:** None.

## Assumptions

- None.

## Accepted defaults

- None.

## Open questions

- None.
